input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Talk Show"?

documents.text: Talk Show (Shae Jones album) Talk Show is the first and only album by R&B singer Shae Jones, released on January 26, 1999 through Uptown Records. The album featured heavy input from Jones' mentor Montell Jordan, who served as an executive producer, producer, song writer, arranger and provided background vocals for the album. The lead single, "Talk Show Shhh!" became a minor hit on the "Billboard" Hot 100, peaking at 88 on the chart. The album itself, however, was not a commercial success, not selling enough copies to make it to the "Billboard" 200 and only found mild success on
